final: WITH race_avg AS (SELECT r.raceId, c.country, AVG(ds.wins) AS w FROM driverStandings ds JOIN races r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY r.raceId, c.country), country_avg AS (SELECT country, AVG(w) AS avg_wins FROM race_avg GROUP BY country), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS o FROM country_avg), above AS (SELECT country, avg_wins FROM country_avg, overall WHERE avg_wins > o), grp AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS g FROM above) SELECT a.country, a.avg_wins, a.avg_wins - overall.o AS above_overall, a.avg_wins - grp.g AS above_group FROM above a, overall, grp WHERE a.avg_wins > grp.g ORDER BY a.avg_wins DESC
